What We Offer

From a relaxed weekday lunch to a private evening for fifty, here's exactly what to expect when you walk through our doors on Del Mar Heights Rd.

Upscale Casual, Made Simple

Nick's Del Mar is a coastal, upscale-casual dining room serving a seasonal Southern California menu — think coastal seafood, wood-grilled plates, craft cocktails, and a dessert list worth saving room for. Whether you're stopping in for a quick bite at the bar or booking a private event for a milestone birthday, here's the full picture of what we do.

01

Dine-In Dining

Open daily from 11am, our dining room and patio welcome walk-ins and reservations alike. Expect a warm, wood-and-linen space designed for lingering — perfect for lunch on the go or a slow, multi-course dinner overlooking Del Mar.

02

Reservations

Booking ahead guarantees your table during our busiest hours — weekend brunch, sunset dinners, and holiday weeks fill quickly. Reserve online or by phone and we'll have your table ready.

Reserve a Table Now
03

Private Events

From rehearsal dinners to corporate gatherings, our team can host private and semi-private events with custom menus built around your group. Reach out to discuss dates, headcounts, and menu options for your Del Mar celebration.

04

Gift Cards

Share Nick's with someone else — gift cards are available for use at any Nick's location across Southern California, from Del Mar to Los Angeles and Orange County.

05

Food Menu

Starters like our bacon deviled eggs, coastal seafood plates, wood-grilled entrees, and hand-built sandwiches like our blackened fish sandwich — built for sharing, built for going back for seconds. Full food menu available online and in-house.

06

Beverage Menu

Craft cocktails, a curated wine list, and local Southern California beers round out our bar program — designed to pair with the coastal menu, not compete with it.

07

Dessert Menu

Finish the night right. Our dessert menu rotates seasonally, built to close out both a quick lunch and a long, celebratory dinner alike.

Nick's Del Mar has been serving Del Mar Heights Rd as part of the wider Nick's restaurant group, with locations across Los Angeles, Orange County, and San Diego. Featured on Tripadvisor and Yelp among Southern California's coastal dining spots, Nick's continues to welcome both new visitors and longtime regulars daily starting at 11am.
